subject: Decision criteria clarification — latency, cost, deployment & SLA (follow-up)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Price <jordan.price@finova.com>, Asha Kumar <asha.kumar@finova.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Decision criteria clarification — latency, cost, deployment & SLA (follow-up)

Thanks again for the time today — great conversation. Quick recap and a few clarifying questions so we can prepare the materials your procurement/security team needs.

Recap (from our discovery)
- Primary POC: Jordan (platform lead). Security contact: Asha. Procurement: procurement@finova.com (you mentioned).
- Workload: interactive assistant in customer-facing app (low concurrency per user, peaks during business hours), plus nightly batch embeddings for search index.
- Key decision criteria called out: latency, unit cost, deployment mode (hosted vs dedicated/private), and SLA/uptime.

Clarifying questions (so we tailor the commercial + technical proposal):
1) Latency: you mentioned sub-200ms for interactive at p95 as a goal — can you confirm target (p50/p95) and whether p99 matters for your UX?
2) Cost: do you have a target unit cost (e.g., $/1k tokens or $/1M tokens) or a monthly budget we should design around for committed capacity?
3) Deployment/Security: is Dedicated capacity with VPC peering sufficient, or do you require an on-prem/private control plane? Any specific KMS/HSM or data residency constraints?
4) SLA: procurement asked about minimum uptime and latency SLOs — what are your internal targets (e.g., 99.9%, 99.95%)?

Next steps from us
- I attached a short SOC2 summary and a latency/cost model template. We will populate the cost model once you confirm the targets above.
- If procurement prefers, we can schedule a 30-min call next week (please suggest times) to walk procurement/security through controls, SOW, and timelines.

Thanks — I CC'd Aditya (Sales Ops) and Lauren (Legal) so they can join relevant calls and prep a draft SOW + pricing based on your answers.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0126

Attachments: SOC2-summary.pdf, redwood-latency-cost-model.xlsx

From: Jordan Price <jordan.price@finova.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Asha Kumar <asha.kumar@finova.com>, Finova Procurement <procurement@finova.com>
Date: Sat, 26 Jun 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Decision criteria clarification — latency, cost, deployment & SLA (follow-up)

Marissa — thanks for the summary and the attach. Asha and I chatted and here are clarifications from our side: 

1) Latency
- Target: interactive UI needs p95 <= 200ms (p50 typically ~40-60ms). p99 is not a blocker but would be nice if below ~400ms.

2) Cost
- We don't have a hard $/1k token target, but procurement is looking for examples that get us under ~$0.10 per 1k tokens for the interactive paths at committed volumes. For embeddings/batch, cost is less sensitive.

3) Deployment/Security
- We prefer Dedicated capacity with VPC peering (no public internet egress for inference traffic). We may ask for private control plane in later stages, but initial pilot should be Dedicated with strong audit logs and KMS integration (AES-256, rotation support).

4) SLA
- Target uptime: 99.95% minimum for production workloads. Latency SLO: p95 target per call as above, with escalation if we see regression vs baseline.

Procurement steps
- Procurement will need: SOC2 report (or summary), DPA, sample SOW, and committed capacity pricing. I attached our procurement intake PDF for your reference. Procurement lead will be looping in next week: procurement@finova.com.

We can do a 30-minute call on Thu 1 Jul between 10:00–12:00 PT to walk through — can you and Aditya make one of those slots?

Thanks,
Jordan
Platform Engineering Manager | Finova
jordan.price@finova.com

Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Decision criteria clarification — latency, cost, deployment & SLA (follow-up)

Jordan — appreciate the detail. That's very helpful. A few quick notes and commitments from our side: 

- Dedicated + VPC peering: we can provide Dedicated GPU pools with VPC peering and private egress for inference; we'll include KMS integration details in the security packet and confirm AES-256 & rotation support.
- Latency: we will run a short pilot to validate p95 <= 200ms for the interactive model you indicated. We'll share a baseline report after warm-up traffic.
- SLA: we can offer a 99.95% uptime SLA as part of a Dedicated commitment; we'll include latency SLO language in the SOW and escalation path.
- Cost: I'll populate the attached cost model with a few committed capacity scenarios that hit around your target economics (~$0.10/1k tokens) so procurement has concrete options (monthly committed GPUs and burst terms).

Next steps
1) I'll schedule the 30-min procurement/security call for Thu 1 Jul at 10:30 PT (send invite shortly). Aditya will join to run through pricing and commitment options; Lauren will be on the invite to discuss the SOW/DPA.
2) I'll send the draft SOW, updated cost model, and our SOC2 summary before the call.

Anything else you want included in the packet (e.g., HSM requirements, specific regulatory controls)?

Best,
Marissa
